title: valeriana vulgaris var. stolonifera
intro: Valeriana vulgaris var. stolonifera, commonly known as Creeping Valerian, is a perennial herb that belongs to the Valerianaceae family. This plant is known for its sedative properties and is often used to treat anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness. The health benefits of Creeping Valerian include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress levels, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates, which are responsible for its sedative and therapeutic actions.
